# /crav1-create-feature-branch

lane: cross-cutting | group: Commit and pull request | starter: no | stage: stable | since: 1.0.0 | prompts: 1
purpose: Create or check out feat/<slug> (one branch for spec+build) or spec/<slug> (specify-only; build later on feat/<slug>).
use_when: Brownfield: leave the default branch
reads: Reads the current branch, the default branch, and whether the tree is dirty.
writes: Writes a local checkout of `feat/<slug>` or `spec/<slug>` after the user picks. When a build prompt picks a branch other than the build map's name for that task, writes `(map: <picked>)` on the task line in the specs repo and does not commit it.
leaves alone: Leaves commits, push, and the pull request alone.
limits: skips the prompt when there is no repo, no commits, or the branch is already right. A dirty tree does not checkout.
flow:
- a task-line branch that is only on origin, or is the head of an open pull request, is offered with a last `checkout: <name>` line.
- The Build prompt then has no card: it says `Using <name> from origin (task line).` and checks the branch out, in the `repo:` checkout when one is printed.
- Prompt for `feat/<slug>` or specify-only `spec/<slug>`; no silent checkout, no push, no PR.
- the Build prompt puts a task's `(branch: …)` first, marked (Recommended), and never creates it from default without asking.
- implementation code is never built on a base branch (main, master, develop, Merges into, `release/*`): no Stay there; Create `feat/<slug>` from the into branch (Recommended), Use an existing branch, Other name or Stop; `hotfix/` is a work prefix; specs, docs and the specs repo are exempt.
- Rules in `references/code-branch.md`.
- a missing task sub-branch is offered as **Create it from the spec branch (Recommended)**; the `(into …)` marker is written after the yes.
- a task's Build prompt offers the branch `scripts/build_map.py --recommend T# --vendor copilot` prints, the same name as the build map row: `(map:)`, else `(branch:)`, else the plan step, else `committed later on`.
- The branch question is its own card, and a typed name on that card is the answer.
- A different pick writes `(map: <picked>)` on the task in the specs repo and does not commit it.
- That is `(map:)`, else `(branch:)`, else a `feat/…` name in the sentence, else `committed later on`.
- `from <base>` after that name is the base, for example `feat/orders-host-setup-scripts from develop`.
- `--recommend` prints the branch on the first line, then `source: task line`, `source: build map`, or `source: new`, and `because:` when a merged or deleted branch was skipped.
- The card lists the recommended option first.
- When `because:` is present, that sentence is the description.
- a typed branch name is that card's free-text answer, hint `Type a branch name`.
called_by: Called by the user, `/crav1-spark-to-spec`, `/crav1-ideas-to-spec`, `/crav1-bundle-to-specs`, `/crav1-existing-to-specs`, `/crav1-build-tasks`, and `/crav1-build-features`.
runs by itself: Calls no skill.
you run next: /crav1-review-architecture; /crav1-tighten-spec; /crav1-finalize-commit
first: `/crav1-create-feature-branch <slug>`
